description: Per-component text fields for the FBM Motors theme. The dashboard /create + /update pages render form inputs per field. The AI brand generator reads this recipe to know what copy to emit. The theme runtime reads brand.text[<key>] first, falls back to defaults below.

fields.label: Hero title — accent word
fields.aiHint: One-word accent word that gets the gradient treatment in the title (e.g. Perfect, Dream, Next, Right).

fields.label: Hero lead paragraph
fields.aiHint: 1-2 sentence sub-headline. State the main customer promise (warranties, breakdown cover, transparency, stock size).

fields.label: Forecourt heading
fields.default: Every car inspected, history-checked, and ready to drive away

fields.label: Reason 1 — detail
fields.default: We don't just simply forget about our customers after a purchase. Every car includes a minimum 3-month warranty and 12 months of AA Breakdown Cover.

fields.label: Reason 2 — detail
fields.default: A strong reputation as a reliable {cityish} dealership — multiple AutoTrader highly-rated awards with an overall rating of 4.9/5.

fields.label: Reason 3 — detail
fields.default: Established relationships with reputable lenders mean competitive financing options matched to your budget and needs.

fields.label: Browse lead
fields.default: Jump straight to the manufacturer you're after.

fields.label: Visit lead (shown if no brand address)
fields.default: Drop in to see the latest stock — we're {cityish}-based and open six days a week.
fields.aiHint: Fallback shown when the brand record has no address. The Home page prefers brand.location.fullAddress / address fields when set.

fields.label: Newsletter lead
fields.default: New stock, exclusive offers, and finance updates — straight to your inbox.

fields.label: About hero lead
fields.default: A {cityish} dealership built on a simple idea: treat every customer the way we'd want to be treated — before, during, and long after the sale.

fields.label: Story heading
fields.default: We don't forget about you after the keys change hands

fields.label: Story paragraph 1
fields.default: {brandName} started in {cityish} with a frustration every car buyer knows: dealerships that disappear the moment the sale completes. We built the opposite — every car we sell carries a minimum 3-month warranty and a full 12 months of AA Breakdown Cover, included as standard.

fields.label: Story paragraph 2
fields.default: That commitment to transparency, quality, and customer service has earned the trust of customers across {cityish} and beyond, and won us AutoTrader's highly-rated award multiple times with an overall rating of 4.9 out of 5.

fields.label: Story paragraph 3
fields.default: Whether you're buying your first car or your fifth, selling, part-exchanging, or arranging finance — you'll deal with real people who answer the phone and stand behind every vehicle on the forecourt.

fields.label: Contact hero lead
fields.default: Questions about a car, finance, or a part exchange? Call, email, or send a message — we typically reply within the hour during opening times.

fields.label: Sell hero lead
fields.default: Get a fair, no-obligation valuation in under 24 hours. We buy outright and take part exchanges — paperwork handled, payment same day.

fields.label: Finance hero lead
fields.default: Estimate your monthly payments before you visit. Adjust the sliders to match your budget — we'll find finance to fit.

fields.label: Finance disclaimer
fields.default: Illustration only — not a finance offer. Actual rates depend on your circumstances and lender approval. {brandName} works with reputable financial institutions to find terms that fit your budget.

fields.label: FAQs hero lead
fields.default: Everything buyers and sellers ask us most. Can't find your answer? We're one message away.

fields.label: Used cars hero lead
fields.default: Every vehicle is inspected, history-checked, and covered by a free 3-month warranty plus 12 months of AA Breakdown Cover.
